defined_only.rationale: PARTIAL BY DESIGN, and the partiality is the point rather than a shortfall. cmd_spec_copy_from_proto runs the value through cmd_patch_orient_y — the same predicate the emit uses, so load and emit cannot come to disagree about which senses are legal — but only for a spec that actually patches an NDC y. An undefined value on a spec with no y slot is never read by anything, so it is inert rather than unguarded; refusing it would buy nothing and cost a load. The guard is also STRICTER than defined_only where it applies: UNSPECIFIED is a defined enumerator, so defined_only alone would admit it, and admitting it means the renderer picks a plane — which is the vertically mirrored command this field exists to prevent. No :range-over, because the guard is an explicit two-arm switch rather than a _MIN/_MAX range test; a hole in the vocabulary could not slip past it.
